project.name: Guitar Ear Training App
project.description: Phone-based ear training app for guitar players. Teaches chord families, naming conventions, and intervals using recorded guitar sounds. Designed for beginner-to-intermediate players practising in found time without an instrument in hand.

identity.summary: 10 years old, Year 6 at a small state primary in the UK. Dirty-knees outdoor kid — plays football and other sports. Chose to start guitar himself six months ago. Has private lessons once a week. Likes the idea of being a guitar player more than the work of becoming one — not self-motivated to grind out practice.
